products.name: Blackbird Aerobook 14
products.description: A 14-inch ultrabook with a USB-C charging port, an NVMe M.2 2280 slot and DDR5 SO-DIMM memory. Charges from any 65W or higher USB-C Power Delivery adapter.
reviews: Light enough for a bag, fast enough for work.
Upgraded the SSD myself in ten minutes.

products.name: Blackbird Aerobook 16
products.description: The 16-inch Aerobook, built for video editing: a bigger screen, an NVMe M.2 2280 slot and DDR5 SO-DIMM memory. Needs a 100W USB-C Power Delivery charger to charge at full speed under load.
reviews: Screen is gorgeous; battery life takes a hit on the largest panel size.

products.name: Blackbird Workmate 15
products.description: Blackbird's budget 15-inch laptop, charged over the older round barrel connector rather than USB-C. Takes a SATA M.2 2280 SSD and DDR4 SO-DIMM memory.
reviews: Does the job for spreadsheets and browsing.
The barrel charger cable is a bit short.

products.name: Corvid Slate 13
products.description: A compact 13-inch laptop with a USB-C charging port, an NVMe M.2 2280 slot and DDR5 SO-DIMM memory.
reviews: Small, solid, and the keyboard is better than it looks.

products.name: Corvid Slate 15 Pro
products.description: Corvid's high-performance 15-inch laptop, with a USB-C charging port, an NVMe M.2 2280 slot and DDR5 SO-DIMM memory. Draws up to 100W under sustained load.
reviews: Fast, but you'll want the 100W charger — the 65W one throttles it.

products.name: Brakk 18V Combi Drill (Body Only)
products.description: A cordless combi drill on the Brakk 18V battery platform. Sold as body only — pick a Brakk 18V battery and charger to go with it.
reviews: Great weight balance for overhead drilling.
Buy it body-only if you already have Brakk 18V batteries.

products.name: Brakk 18V Drill Kit (2x4.0Ah + Case)
products.description: The Brakk 18V combi drill bundled with two 4.0Ah batteries, a fast charger and a carry case.
reviews: Everything you need in one box.

products.name: Brakk 18V Impact Driver (Body Only)
products.description: A cordless impact driver on the Brakk 18V battery platform. Sold as body only.
reviews: Punches through long screws without stalling.

products.name: Tornio 20V MAX Drill (Body Only)
products.description: A cordless drill on the Tornio 20V MAX battery platform. "20V MAX" is the fully-charged peak voltage; the platform runs at the same 18V nominal as most 18V tool ranges, but the batteries are not interchangeable.
reviews: Powerful, but you need Tornio's own batteries.

products.name: Brakk 18V LED Work Light (Body Only)
products.description: A cordless LED work light that runs on a Brakk 18V battery. Sold as body only.
reviews: Bright enough for a dim garage.

products.name: Blackbird 65W USB-C Charger
products.description: The official 65W USB-C Power Delivery charger for the Blackbird Aerobook 14 and Aerobook 16. Black rectangular laptop power adapter with a folding plug.
reviews: Exactly what came in the box, handy as a spare.

products.name: Voltline 65W USB-C GaN Charger
products.description: Compact 65W gallium-nitride power adapter with a single USB-C Power Delivery port. A black rectangular laptop power adapter, small enough to fit in a jacket pocket. Charges phones and laptops alike.
reviews: Charges my ultrabook from flat in under two hours.
Small enough to leave in the laptop bag.

products.name: Voltline 100W USB-C GaN Charger
products.description: A 100W USB-C Power Delivery charger, sized for laptops that draw more power under load, such as the Corvid Slate 15 Pro.
reviews: Runs my 15-inch laptop at full speed while charging.

products.name: Voltline 45W Barrel Charger
products.description: A 45W laptop charger with the older round barrel connector. A black rectangular laptop power adapter that reads almost identically to Voltline's USB-C models, but the plug and the wattage are both different.
reviews: Compact and does the job for my older laptop.

products.name: Voltline 90W Barrel Charger
products.description: A 90W laptop charger with the older round barrel connector — plenty of power, but the wrong plug for a USB-C laptop.
reviews: Solid build, but check your laptop's charging port before buying.

products.name: Voltline 45W USB-C Charger
products.description: A 45W USB-C Power Delivery charger — the right connector for a USB-C laptop, but not enough power for models that need 65W or more.
reviews: Fine for topping up, too slow for a full charge from flat.

products.name: Voltline 20W USB-C Phone Charger
products.description: A pocket-sized 20W USB-C charger, sized for a phone's smaller battery rather than a laptop.
reviews: Perfect little charger for the nightstand.

products.name: Kestrel 1TB NVMe M.2 2280 SSD
products.description: A 1TB solid-state drive in the M.2 2280 form factor, connecting over the NVMe protocol for the fastest laptop upgrade speeds.
reviews: Boots in seconds; easy drop-in upgrade.

products.name: Kestrel 1TB SATA M.2 2280 SSD
products.description: A 1TB solid-state drive in the same M.2 2280 form factor as Kestrel's NVMe drive, connecting over the older SATA protocol. Looks identical to the NVMe model; the slot it fits is not always the slot it works in.
reviews: Fits fine physically, just make sure your laptop's M.2 slot supports SATA.

products.name: Kestrel 2TB NVMe M.2 2280 SSD
products.description: A 2TB solid-state drive in the M.2 2280 form factor, connecting over the NVMe protocol.
reviews: Plenty of room for a photo library.

products.name: Kestrel 500GB SATA M.2 2280 SSD
products.description: A budget 500GB solid-state drive in the M.2 2280 form factor, connecting over the SATA protocol.
reviews: Good value for a secondary drive.

products.name: Kestrel 16GB DDR5 SO-DIMM
products.description: A 16GB DDR5 SO-DIMM memory module for laptops with DDR5 memory controllers.
reviews: Recognised immediately, no BIOS fuss.

products.name: Kestrel 16GB DDR4 SO-DIMM
products.description: A 16GB DDR4 SO-DIMM memory module for laptops with DDR4 memory controllers. DDR5 and DDR4 modules are not interchangeable, even though both use the SO-DIMM shape.
reviews: Works well in my older laptop.

products.name: Kestrel 32GB DDR5 SO-DIMM Kit (2x16GB)
products.description: A matched pair of 16GB DDR5 SO-DIMM modules for laptops that support dual-channel memory.
reviews: Both sticks tested together, no compatibility issues.

products.name: Kestrel 8GB DDR4 SO-DIMM
products.description: An 8GB DDR4 SO-DIMM memory module, a cheap way to add a second stick to a laptop with a free slot.
reviews: Cheap and simple upgrade.

products.name: Brakk 18V 4.0Ah Battery
products.description: A 4.0Ah battery pack for the Brakk 18V cordless drill and impact driver platform.
reviews: Lasts a full afternoon of drilling.

products.name: Brakk 18V 2.0Ah Battery
products.description: A lighter 2.0Ah battery pack for the Brakk 18V cordless platform, for shorter jobs where weight matters more than runtime.
reviews: Good spare battery to keep charged.

products.name: Tornio 20V MAX 4.0Ah Battery
products.description: A 4.0Ah battery pack for the Tornio 20V MAX cordless platform (18V nominal cell voltage). Reads almost identically to a Brakk 18V pack on the shelf, but the two platforms are not interchangeable.
reviews: Great runtime, but only fits Tornio 20V MAX tools.

products.name: Brakk 12V 2.0Ah Battery
products.description: A 2.0Ah battery pack for Brakk's smaller 12V cordless platform — a different platform from Brakk's 18V tools, despite sharing the Brakk name.
reviews: Fits my compact Brakk driver, not the bigger 18V drill.

products.name: Brakk 18V Fast Charger
products.description: A fast charger for Brakk 18V battery packs.
reviews: Charges a 4.0Ah pack in under an hour.

products.name: Tornio 20V MAX Charger
products.description: A charger for Tornio 20V MAX battery packs.
reviews: Does what it says, nothing fancy.

products.name: Hollis Cordless Phone Battery Pack
products.description: Replacement rechargeable battery pack for Hollis cordless phones. Fits the Hollis DECT cordless phone base and handset models — no screwdriver or drill needed, simply clip the battery pack into the handset's battery compartment.
reviews: Easy fit, phone holds charge again.
Cordless phone battery arrived quickly and clips straight in.

products.name: Hollis Cordless Phone Twin Pack
products.description: A DECT cordless phone base with two handsets, for a home with more than one room to cover.
reviews: Clear reception throughout the house.

products.name: Hollis Phone Charging Cradle
products.description: A replacement desktop charging cradle for Hollis cordless phone handsets.
reviews: Exact match for my existing handset.

products.name: Voltline 10000mAh Power Bank
products.description: A pocket-sized 10000mAh power bank with an 18W USB-C output, for topping up a phone away from a socket.
reviews: Charges my phone twice over.

products.name: Voltline USB-C Hub 100W Pass-Through
products.description: A USB-C hub adding HDMI, USB-A and card-reader ports, with 100W power pass-through so a laptop can charge and connect through the one port.
reviews: Handy for a single-cable desk setup.

products.name: Blackbird Laptop Sleeve 14"
products.description: A padded neoprene sleeve sized for 14-inch laptops.
reviews: Snug fit for the Aerobook 14.

products.name: Kestrel 128GB USB Stick
products.description: A compact 128GB USB flash drive for backups and file transfers.
reviews: Small and quick, does what it says.

products.name: Anvik 25-Piece Drill Bit Set
products.description: A 25-piece set of drill and screwdriver bits in a storage case, fitting any standard hex-shank drill.
reviews: Good range of sizes for household jobs.

products.name: Pinegrove USB-C to USB-C Cable 2m
products.description: A 2-metre USB-C to USB-C cable rated for 100W charging and 10Gbps data.
reviews: Long enough to reach from the desk to the sofa.

products.name: Brakk 18V 5.0Ah Battery Twin Pack
products.description: Two 5.0Ah battery packs for the Brakk 18V cordless platform, sold as a pair for heavy use.
reviews: Never run out mid-job with two of these on charge.

products.name: Solace Bluetooth Speaker
products.description: A compact splash-resistant Bluetooth speaker with 12 hours of battery life.
reviews: Punchy sound for its size.

products.name: Pinegrove Wireless Mouse
products.description: A wireless mouse with a USB-C rechargeable battery.
reviews: Comfortable for all-day use.

products.name: Pinegrove Mechanical Keyboard
products.description: A compact mechanical keyboard with hot-swappable switches.
reviews: Satisfying to type on, quieter than I expected.

products.name: Solace Over-Ear Headphones
products.description: Over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation.
reviews: Great for blocking out an open-plan office.

products.name: Anvik Tool Box
products.description: A stackable plastic tool box with a removable tray, sized for a cordless drill and its accessories.
reviews: Sturdy enough for the shed.

products.name: Anvik Safety Glasses
products.description: Impact-resistant safety glasses with anti-fog coating.
reviews: Comfortable enough to wear for a whole job.

products.name: Anvik Work Gloves
products.description: Padded work gloves with reinforced grip panels.
reviews: Good grip without being bulky.

products.name: Voltline 12W USB-C Fast Charger
products.description: A small 12W USB-C charger, sized for a phone rather than a laptop.
reviews: Cheap spare charger for the kitchen.

products.name: Kestrel 2TB External SSD
products.description: A 2TB portable SSD in a USB-C enclosure, for backups and fast external storage.
reviews: Fast enough to edit video straight off the drive.

products.name: Kestrel USB-C Card Reader
products.description: A USB-C card reader supporting SD and microSD cards.
reviews: Reads full-size and micro SD cards at once.

products.name: Blackbird 15-Inch Laptop Backpack
products.description: A padded backpack with a dedicated 15-inch laptop compartment.
reviews: Fits a laptop, charger and lunch with room to spare.

products.name: Blackbird 1080p Webcam
products.description: A clip-on 1080p webcam with a built-in privacy shutter.
reviews: Clear picture for video calls.

products.name: Corvid Adjustable Monitor Stand
products.description: A height-adjustable monitor stand with cable-management channels.
reviews: Sturdy and easy to assemble.

products.name: Pinegrove Extension Cable 5m
products.description: A 5-metre 3-pin mains extension cable with a single socket.
reviews: Reaches across the room without a second extension.

products.name: Anvik 8m Tape Measure
products.description: An 8-metre retractable tape measure with a locking blade.
reviews: Reliable and easy to read.

products.name: Hollis Phone Screen Protector (2 Pack)
products.description: Two tempered-glass screen protectors with an alignment tray for bubble-free fitting.
reviews: Went on first try, no bubbles.

products.name: Hollis Phone Case
products.description: A slim shock-absorbing phone case with raised edges to protect the screen.
reviews: Slim but survived a drop onto concrete.

products.name: Tornio 20V MAX Work Light (Body Only)
products.description: A cordless LED work light that runs on a Tornio 20V MAX battery. Sold as body only.
reviews: Wide beam, good for lighting a whole work area.

products.name: Brakk 18V Angle Grinder (Body Only)
products.description: A cordless angle grinder on the Brakk 18V battery platform. Sold as body only.
reviews: Enough power for cutting and light grinding jobs.
